header: Watch a manager build a week from scratch
bodytext: A real branch, a real spring week and a duty manager who has used the planner for four months. Nothing is sped up and nothing is cut, including the part where a rest-period warning stops her and she has to move two shifts to get around it.
caption: Recorded at a three-till branch in March, published with the customer's permission.
note: 9 min 12 s · captions in German and English
